profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Ally
profile.summary:
I enjoy ruminating on problems and seeking optimal solutions for compute time as memory optimizations are less interesting to solve for generally.

Do not contact me in regards to front-end nor full-stack "opportunities," and do not contact me in regards to Java "opportunities."

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Back-end engineer and technical architect in the FinTech industry

* Moved to a small, unique team of SMEs within the business vertical with a primary specialization in authentication/authorization and a secondary specialization in architecture
* Developed in several frameworks including .NET Core, .NET, Spring Boot, and Node.js
* Comfortable with a vast array of technologies including AWS, Docker, Apigee, IdentityServer4, Zuul and Eureka, Jenkins, AppDynamics, and SQL Server
* Architected and delivered on numerous business-critical projects including a new and rapidly growing $6M in yearly revenue lending program, a high-performance websocket streaming application projected to cut yearly costs by $6M and a high-performance reverse proxy designed to aid in reducing technical debt
* Actively participated in communities of practice to establish quality coding standards, patterns and architecture
* Triaged countless issues across all environments to reduce waste
* Established quality relationships with stakeholders and engineers alike across the enterprise

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead a small team of engineers in the continued maintenance and growth of a $250MM in revenue business

* Developed in several frameworks including .NET Core, .NET, Symfony, and React/Redux
* Worked with various technologies including Docker, ELK, New Relic, Jenkins, MySQL, and SQL Server
* Engaged in regular collaboration and development across a multitude of business verticals
* Assisted in the launch of a brand new business along with the architecture and implementation
* Ensured business data integrity and increased uptime with quality relationships and communication with support teams and third-party vendors
* Leveraged real-time analytics and full-stack logging to create runbooks for NOC teams
* Regularly mentored teammates and fostered a constructive and individualized environment
* Deprecated several major legacy systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as an adaptive, performant member on a large international R&D team within the automotive industry

* Developed in several frameworks including Qt/QML, Node.js and Vue.js
* Broad exposure to a plethora of languages including C++, Haxe, Javascript, Typescript, Golang, HTML, and CSS
* Collaborated on the design and development of a suite of RPC-connected and cloud-integrated applications
* Architected and broke ground on third-party connected services POCs utilising gRPC that reduced time to MVP by ~90% and attained stakeholder interest and buy-in
* Pioneered exploration and co-led development to enable cloud integration within the product suite
Spearheaded architecture, development and distribution of internal tooling targeted at accelerating the SDLC
* Initiated and transitioned products to a CI/CD workflow to eliminate waste

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Researching flaws and shortcomings of existing automated Android software testing frameworks and developing a new prototype framework.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: BI intern who operated autonomously on an interactive Tableau dashboard project targeted at helping leadership to quickly and conveniently visualize KPIs at HQ
